title: Step-by-Step Guide to Business Central API Queries
summary: This post explains how to create Query objects configured as APIs in Business Central to expose data for external systems like Power BI and Power Automate. It demonstrates building a Vendor Ledger API and connecting it to Power BI for reporting, highlighting advantages like handling related records and enforcing read-only access.
key_points: Query objects configured with API settings (APIGroup, APIPublisher, APIVersion, QueryType = API) automatically expose data to external systems
Query-based APIs handle related records easily and can nest several layers deep without requiring separate list parts
Query APIs are read-only by nature, preventing accidental write operations and protecting data integrity when shared with reporting teams
Query APIs can be directly connected to Power BI using the Dynamics 365 Business Central connector to build reports
